name: Concert of Europe
description: 20 November 1815: the Second Treaty of Paris closes the Napoleonic Wars and the victors renew their Quadruple Alliance to guard the Vienna settlement. Britain rules the waves, Spain fights rebels from Mexico to the Andes, the Company wars on Nepal and the Ottomans hold the Balkans, while Qing China and Tokugawa Japan look inward.
approximations: Borders follow modern admin-1 provinces, so each province goes to whoever held most of it on 20 November 1815; many 1815 states are smaller than a province and are folded into a neighbour: Baden and Hohenzollern into Württemberg, Brunswick, Oldenburg and Bremen into Hanover, Hesse-Kassel, Hesse-Darmstadt, Nassau and Frankfurt into one Hesse, the Ernestine duchies, Schwarzburg and Reuss into the Saxon Duchies, the Bavarian Palatinate into Prussia's Rhineland, Holstein, Hamburg and Lübeck into Denmark, Luxembourg into the Netherlands, Kraków into Austria, Parma, Modena and Lucca into Tuscany and the Papal States, Liguria and Savoy follow their provinces (Savoy stays French), the Ionian Islands, Heligoland, Penang, the Gold Coast forts, Gorée and Pondicherry are not shown, and Bukovina goes with Moldavia. Salzburg (handed over by Bavaria in May 1816) is Austrian and French Guiana and Saint-Louis (returned by Portugal and Britain in 1817) are French from the start, and Suriname and the Dutch Antilles (handed back in 1816) Dutch; Java and the Moluccas start British and return to the Dutch by event. Personal unions and vassals are subjects: Hanover of Britain, Congress Poland and Finland of Russia, Norway of Sweden, Egypt, Serbia, Wallachia and Moldavia of the Ottomans, the Lao kingdoms of Siam, Cambodia of Vietnam and Dahomey of Oyo. The Barbary regencies are shown independent, as they were in practice. British India is the East India Company as its own country, allied to Britain, with Hyderabad, Mysore, Travancore and Baroda as its subsidiary-alliance subjects; Awadh is folded into the Company's Uttar Pradesh, Holkar's Indore and Bhopal into Gwalior, the Bhonsle lands of Berar into the Peshwa's Maharashtra, and the Rajput principalities into one Rajput States. The Company is given absolute monarchy as the nearest government type. The Spanish American wars are one war of Spain against the patriot governments still standing (New Granada and the Río de la Plata); royalist-held Mexico, Central America, Venezuela, Quito, Peru, Upper Peru and Chile are Spanish, and the later states are dormant until released by events, which also gives them a truce with Spain. Artigas's Federal League holds the Banda Oriental and the Littoral; Uruguay is not modelled as a later release. The United States is drawn with its states and organised territories east of the Mississippi plus Louisiana, Missouri and Arkansas; the rest of the Louisiana Purchase, the Oregon Country, Rupert's Land, the Great Plains, the Spanish American Amazon, Patagonia, the Chaco and Araucanía, inland Australia, New Zealand, Chukotka, Sakhalin, most of the Kazakh steppe, the Turkmen and Kyrgyz lands, Circassia and Chechnya, the Sahara and the Horn, and most of Africa, the Malay world and the Pacific are unowned: their peoples and many smaller states (the Kazakh hordes, Wadai, the Lunda, Luba and Kongo states, Buganda, the Zulu, Sakalava and Fante polities, the Gulf sheikhdoms, the south Arabian sultanates, Manipur, Ladakh, Perak and Selangor, the Sulu and Bugis sultanates) are not modelled. Brazil's Amazon interior, Spanish Texas, New Mexico and California and Russian Alaska are given to the claimant although control was thin. Tibet and Mongolia are part of the Qing Empire, Ryukyu and Ezo part of Japan, Kashmir and Peshawar part of the Durrani Empire with Kalat folded in. Population (millions) and GDP (billions of 1990 international dollars) are rounded Maddison-style estimates projected back to 1815, including colonies, and are uncertain outside Europe by a third or more; within a country population follows today's distribution, flattened. Armies are rounded post-war peacetime strengths, and both armies and navies are cut by the upkeep caps. Technology lags are judgements. The Quadruple Alliance and the German Confederation (its German members only; the kings of Denmark and the Netherlands belonged for Holstein and Luxembourg alone) are defence blocs; the Holy Alliance is not modelled because it carried no military obligation.
